test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. “Well, you can’t make me”, she said, looking back at me.

B. She went on, “Well, you might try”, I responded, and she laughed.

C. She came in and we said hello, then she just looked at me and said, “What do you want?” McKechnie remembered.

D. “Well, I want you to grin and seem pleased”, I added.
solution:
The correct sequence is: **CDAB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the correct order of the sentences.
 
• Sentence **C **sets the context of the conversation and introduces the speaker.
 
• Sentence **D **is the response of the speaker to the question asked in sentence C.
 
• Sentence **A **shows a playful banter between the two speakers.
 
• Sentence **B **is a concluding statement made by one of the speakers.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Corrected sequence:** ***C**. She came in and we said hello, then she just looked at me and said, “What do you want?” McKechnie remembered. **D**. “Well, I want you to grin and seem pleased”, I added. **A**. “Well, you can’t make me”, she said, looking back at me. **B**. She went on, “Well, you might try”, I responded, and she laughed.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: (**ACBD**) has the first two sentences in the wrong order.
 
• Option 2: (**DCBA**) has the last two sentences in the wrong order.
 
• Option 3: (**BCDA**) has the first and last sentences in the wrong order.
